title_zh: 把回忆写作缩小到一次真实经历

scenario.goal_zh: 选定真实经历中的具体事件并拟定题目

context_zh: 学生准备一篇回忆录章节作业，教师帮助其从整段童年中选择一个具体事件和标题。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I have written a chapter about every school I went to, but it is already far too long.

sentences.speaker: Ms Bell
sentences.text: The aim of this assignment is to describe one real event in detail. Which moment do you remember most clearly?

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: The morning I got locked out of school and the caretaker helped me.

sentences.speaker: Ms Bell
sentences.text: Good. Make that your central event. What happened first?

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I arrived late, found the gate locked, and thought everyone had gone on a trip.

sentences.speaker: Ms Bell
sentences.text: That gives the reader a clear problem. You can leave out the history of the other schools.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Then I will call it The Morning at the Locked Gate and start with me standing outside.

sentences.speaker: Ms Bell
sentences.text: That is specific enough. Draft that scene first, and we can look at the ending tomorrow.
